description: Place an image, PDF, vector or other file in the active document as a smart object (File > Place Embedded), or as a smart object linked to the file (File > Place Linked), positioned, scaled and rotated

center.description: Where the placed item's centre goes, in pixels from the top-left. Default the document centre

filePath.description: Absolute path of the file to place

linked.description: Link to the file instead of embedding it. Default false

name: place_file
title: Place File
